P: Those qualifications and years of experience matter, but they are not the whole
blocks.text: Those qualifications and years of experience matter, but they are not the whole of good tutoring. For me, the starting point is the student. I want students to be comfortable saying when they do not understand something, because there is no value in nodding along to an explanation that has not landed. I use conversation, questions and carefully chosen tasks to see what a student understands, and I change the pace or approach when the evidence tells me to.

blocks.label: P: I believe students can be challenged and supported at the same time. I will be h
blocks.text: I believe students can be challenged and supported at the same time. I will be honest about what needs work, help turn a large goal into manageable next steps and expect the student to take an active part in the process. Ultimately, I want students to understand more and trust themselves more — to become increasingly able to work things out without waiting for someone else to tell them what to do.

H2: International education
P: I spent about 20 years living and working internationally, teaching students fro
blocks.text: I spent about 20 years living and working internationally, teaching students from many backgrounds and working within different school systems. That has given me a broad view of education and shown me something practical: a student can move from one school or curriculum to another and suddenly appear to have “gaps” simply because the sequence, terminology or expectations have changed. I understand how important it is to find those gaps without turning them into a judgement about the student’s ability.

blocks.label: P: I have also led science departments in Vietnam and Barbados and worked in curric
blocks.text: I have also led science departments in Vietnam and Barbados and worked in curriculum development, assessment and teacher mentoring.

blocks.label: H3: IB Biology assessment experience
P: Since 2013, I have worked as an IB Biology Assistant Examiner, with experience a
blocks.text: Since 2013, I have worked as an IB Biology Assistant Examiner, with experience assessing HL Paper 2 and Internal Assessments against IB criteria. That work has given me a close understanding of how IB assessment criteria are applied and, importantly, of the difference between knowing the science and communicating that knowledge effectively under assessment conditions.
